How Samjho Calculators Work

Every calculator on Samjho runs entirely in your web browser using JavaScript. When you enter a loan amount, interest rate, or date of birth, the calculation happens locally on your device. Your numbers are never sent to any server, stored in any database, or shared with any third party.

Close the page and your numbers disappear. Refresh the page and your numbers disappear. This is by design — Samjho calculators are tools for quick estimates, not financial records.

What You Can Calculate

Our calculators cover the most common everyday financial and academic calculations for Indians:

  • EMI Calculator — Estimate monthly loan instalments for home, car, or personal loans. See total interest and repayment amount.
  • GST Calculator — Add or remove GST from any amount. Works for 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28% GST rates.
  • CGPA Calculator — Convert your CGPA to percentage and vice versa. Useful for job applications and college admissions.
  • Age Calculator — Find your exact age in years, months, and days from any date of birth. Useful for form filling and eligibility checks.
  • Discount Calculator — See how much you save during a sale and what the final price is after the discount.
  • Simple Interest Calculator — Calculate interest on savings or loans using the simple interest formula.

Accuracy Notice

These calculators give you quick estimates for personal planning. For official calculations (bank loan approvals, tax filings, government form submissions), always use the calculator or tool provided by the relevant authority — your bank, the Income Tax Department, or the calculator on the official portal.
